title: Files with spaces in the name don't show up in listings
why: Only one specific file is missing, and the rest of the directory looks right.
finding: A logpoint in `RepositoryTree` sampled 84 renders across the recording. 'chapter-one' was present in every one, and 'my file' was missing (index −1) in every one.
actual: The docs directory listing renders only chapter-one.md, notes/draft.md, src/index.ts, guide-old.md and README.md. No entry named "my file.md" is rendered anywhere in the listing: a Logpoint inside the RepositoryTree component (84 sampled tree renders spanning the whole recording) reads the tree's rendered shadow-DOM text at URL /tree/main/docs and returns hasChapter=true but idxMyFile=-1 — the string "my file" never appears in any sampled render, including after the user scrolls to look for it below the fold.
expected: At /maple/reading-room/tree/main/docs the listing should show every file in the docs directory, including both "chapter-one.md" and the file named exactly "my file.md", as the journey scenario requires ("verify chapter-one.md and the file named exactly my file.md are both visible and the breadcrumb path is docs"). A file whose name contains a space should render in the directory listing like any other entry.

chronology.text: The user activates the 'docs' directory link in the reading-room file tree with a real pointer click; the app navigates from /maple/reading-room/tree/main to /maple/reading-room/tree/main/docs (confirmed by the URL change and the breadcrumb 'reading-room / docs').

rootCause.text: The RepositoryTree file-tree component (assets/RepositoryTree-BIhBVSqC.js, function Uc) never renders a row for the file named with a space ("my file.md") in the docs directory view: a Logpoint evaluation anchored inside the component (Point:80, ~90066ms, URL http://127.0.0.1:61787/maple/reading-room/tree/main/docs) reads the component's rendered shadow-DOM text and returns hasChapter=true while idxMyFile=-1 — the string "my file" appears in none of the 84 sampled tree renders across the recording, so the docs listing renders only chapter-one.md, notes/draft.md, src/index.ts, guide-old.md and README.md and omits the required "my file.md" entry the journey fixture seeds. The filename containing a space is dropped from the listing the tree component renders.
